login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your dispatch workspace.
login.invalid: That email and password combination is not recognized.
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
login.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact your administrator.
login.unverified: Verify your email before signing in. We sent a new link.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.invalid: That code is not valid. Codes rotate every 30 seconds.
mfa.setupSubtitle: Scan this code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or any TOTP app.
mfa.recoveryBody: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe — they are the only way in if you lose your device.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.emailBody: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way: {email}
forgot.expired: That reset link has expired. Request a new one.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Your password has been updated. Sign in to continue.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.sent: We sent a verification link to {email}.
verify.emailBody: Open this link to verify your email address: {email}

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.subtitle: {inviter} invited you to join {tenant} as {role}.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite.emailSubject: You're invited to join {tenant} on Goliath Dispatch
invite.emailBody: {inviter} invited you to join {tenant} as {role}. Accept your invitation: {link}

signup.title: Start your dispatch company
signup.subtitle: Fourteen-day trial. No card required to explore.

companyStep.title: Your dispatch company
companyStep.subtitle: This becomes the name your carriers and customers see.

admin.title: Create your admin account
admin.subtitle: You will sign in with this email and manage the workspace.

planStep.title: Choose a plan
planStep.subtitle: You can change plans later from billing settings.
planStep.trialNotice: {days}-day free trial. No card required today.

consentsStep.title: Review and accept
consentsStep.subtitle: Confirm the agreements below to create your workspace.

provisioningStep.title: Creating your workspace
provisioningStep.subtitle: This takes a few seconds — setting up your account, default templates and compliance rules.

successPage.title: You're all set
successPage.body: We emailed a verification link to {email}. Confirm your address, then sign in to finish setting up your workspace.

consent.privacy: I have read and accept the {link}.
consent.sms: I agree to receive operational SMS messages. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
consent.esign: I consent to sign documents electronically and to receive records electronically.

session.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
session.revoked: This session was ended by an administrator.

impersonation.banner: You are viewing {tenant} as {name}. Everything you do is recorded.
impersonation.reasonHint: This is stored in the audit trail and visible to the tenant administrator.
